about:
MAHLE Engine Components USA, Inc. is headquartered in Russellville, Arkansas. The global MAHLE Group was founded in 1920 and has grown into a major automotive supplier. The U.S. entity operates as part of this international technology group.

The company develops and manufactures components for internal combustion engines, electric powertrains, and thermal management systems. Its product portfolio includes e-motors such as the SCT E-Motor, the X20 e-bike drive system, range extenders for electric trucks, and the chargeBIG charging network. Globally, MAHLE employs 64,242 people across 127 production locations and 11 R&D centers, generating 11.3 billion EUR in annual sales.

MAHLE serves the passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors, supplying original equipment manufacturers as well as the aftermarket through its Lifecycle and Mobility division, which provides spare parts and services to trade partners, workshops, and engine repair shops. The company also addresses the e-mobility market, including e-bikes and heavy-duty electric trucks.

MAHLE positions itself as a partner for climate-neutral mobility, focusing on electrification, thermal management, and low-emission combustion technologies that can run on renewable fuels such as hydrogen. The company notes that one in every two vehicles worldwide is equipped with MAHLE components.
